theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_ss_testForm_level_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U n), Continuous f → Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) {x | f x = t} → ∃ η₁ η₂ : TestFormOn U n, η = η₁ + η₂ ∧ tsupport (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ {x | f x < t} ∧ tsupport (η₂ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ {x | t < f x}
